attempts.summary: On node1 (RHEL 7.9), built a local yum package repository from local storage (/var/www/html/localrepo) using downloaded RPMs (tree-1.6.0-10.el7.x86_64.rpm plus createrepo-generated metadata), served it via httpd on the node's IP, then blocked outbound access to remote mirrors (iptables REJECT on ports 80/443 except to self) and confirmed the remote mirror became unreachable while the local repo stayed reachable. Installed the `tree` package successfully from the local repo (confirmed via `@localrepo` origin and working binary). Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id/service state, issued a native `shutdown -r now` reboot whose ack returned before disconnect, polled until the node was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed (e9250ad1... -> 77739820...) and uptime reset to the reboot time, and verified post-restart that httpd was active, the local repo still served 200 on repodata, and the tree package/binary remained installed and functional.
